entrada.descricao: Focused writing: stories, chapters and scenes, an idea bank and a full-screen page with nothing around it. Works on computers and phones.
entrada.sem-conta.texto: Start right now, without signing in. Your texts stay only on this device, in this browser. Whenever you like, sign in and take everything to the cloud.
erro.login: Your session ended. Sign in again to save to the cloud; until then, everything stays saved on this device.
erro.csrf: The page was open for too long. Reload to keep sending to the cloud.
erro.dados: The server did not understand the request.
erro.muitos: Too many things at once. The Writer will send them bit by bit.
erro.cota: Your account reached its cloud space limit. New texts stay saved on this device.
erro.grande: The upload was too big for the server.
erro.servidor: The server had a problem. The Writer will try again by itself.
erro.rede: No internet. Everything stays saved on this device.
erro.recusado: The server refused a text. It is still kept on this device.
erro.invalido: A record was damaged and the server did not accept it.
erro.grande_demais: A scene went over 5 MB and was not sent to the cloud. Split it into smaller scenes.
erro.nao-existe: This no longer exists (maybe it was deleted on another device).
nuvem.sem-rede: No internet: saved on this device
nuvem.memoria: Memory only: the browser did not allow saving, and texts disappear when closed. Export before leaving.
cmd.entrar: Sign in to the Ekfrase account
cmd.topo: Show or hide the top bar
estante.vazia: No stories yet. Start with New story.
estante.sem-conta: You are writing without an account: everything stays only on this device. Sign in to the Ekfrase account (at the top) to save to the cloud and open it on other devices.
estante.memoria: This browser did not allow saving. Texts stay only in memory and disappear when the page closes. Export before leaving.
conflito.explica: The same scene was changed on two devices. Nothing was lost: the other version became a sibling scene. Read it, merge what you want, then keep or delete the copy.
historia.nao-existe: This story no longer exists (maybe it was deleted on another device).
historia.apagar-pergunta: Delete the story {titulo}, with all its chapters, scenes and characters? The ideas stay.
meta.rotulo: How much of the goal is written
capitulo.apagar-pergunta: Delete the chapter {titulo} and its scenes?
cena.nao-existe: This scene no longer exists (maybe it was deleted on another device).
arvore.dica: Use the arrows to move around, Alt with the arrows to move items, Enter to open and F2 to rename. With the mouse, drag by the handle.
arvore.vazia: No scenes yet. Create a chapter or a scene.
escrever.dica: Write here. Two hyphens become an em dash.
ideias.vazio: No ideas yet. Jot down the first one with Ctrl+I, from any screen.
ideias.nenhuma-solta: No loose ideas. Ctrl+I jots one down from any screen.
ideia.dica-enter: Enter saves; Shift+Enter adds a line. The first line becomes the title.
ideia.etiquetas-dica: Separate with commas: magic, north, summer
historico.explica: The Writer keeps a version every 5 minutes of writing and every time you leave the scene. Pick one to read; going back to it does not erase the current text.
historico.voltar-pergunta: Go back to the text from {quando}? The current text stays in the history.
historico.voltou: Done: the scene went back to that version.
exportar.md-dica: The whole story in a single text file.
exportar.zip-dica: One folder per chapter, one .md per scene.
exportar.ekfr-dica: Everything in the story, to open again in the Writer.
importar.explica: Accepts Writer .ekfr, .md and Markdown .zip files. What comes in becomes a new story; nothing you already have is replaced.
importar.outro-app: This file belongs to {app}. Open it there?
importar.app-desconhecido: This file is from an Ekfrase app this Writer does not know yet ({app}).
importar.erro.nao-e-ekfr: This file is not an .ekfr (or it is damaged).
importar.erro.sem-envelope: This .zip has no stories the Writer recognizes.
importar.erro.envelope-invalido: The file is incomplete or damaged.
importar.erro.envelope-novo: This file is from a newer Ekfrase version. Reload the page.
importar.erro.outro-app: This file belongs to another Ekfrase app.
importar.erro.versao-nova: This file is from a newer Writer version. Reload the page.
importar.erro.tipo-desconhecido: The Writer does not know this kind of file.
importar.erro.app-desconhecido: This file is from an Ekfrase app this Writer does not know yet.
importar.erro.conteudo-invalido: The file is from the Writer, but its content is damaged.
importar.erro.vazio: There was nothing to import in this file.
abrir.venceu: This file did not arrive (the link expired or was already used). Open the file again.
paleta.buscar: Type what you want to do
atalhos.texto-arvore: In the text and the scene list
atalho.travessao: Two hyphens become an em dash
atalho.tab: Leave the text and move through the buttons
atalho.entrar: Put the scene in the chapter
atalho.sair: Take the scene out of the chapter
atalho.esc: Close the window; on the page, show or hide the top bar
ajustes.maquina-dica: The line you are writing stays in the middle of the screen.
ajustes.foco-dica: The current paragraph stands out and the rest fades.
ajustes.amostra: Once upon a time there was a blank page.
ajustes.onde-conta: On this device and in the cloud, in {nome}'s account.
ajustes.onde-local: Only on this device, in this browser. Sign in to save to the cloud.
ajustes.onde-memoria: Memory only: they disappear when the page closes. Export before leaving.
levar.texto: Before signing in, you wrote on this device without an account (stories: {historias}; ideas: {ideias}). Take everything to {nome}'s account? That way it goes to the cloud.
levar.feito: Done: the texts are in your account and are going to the cloud.
escrever.outra-aba: This scene changed in another tab. That text is saved in the scene history.
sessao.saiu: You left your account, or the session ended. What you wrote is saved on this device: sign in again to keep going and send it to the cloud.
importar.erro.cena-grande: A scene in this file is over 4 MB and would not go to the cloud. Split it into smaller scenes before importing.
computador.pasta.texto: Choose a folder on this computer or on a USB drive. Your writing stays there, encrypted with a password of your own.
computador.sem-conta.texto: Start now, without signing in. Your writing stays only in the folder you chose, encrypted with your password. Whenever you like, sign in and take everything to the cloud.
computador.ajustes.onde-local: Only on this computer, in the chosen folder, encrypted. Sign in to keep a copy in the cloud too.
computador.pasta.sumiu: The folder from last time is not here: {pasta}. If it was on a USB drive, plug it in and try again, or choose another folder.
computador.criar.titulo: Create the password for your writing
computador.criar.texto: Everything you write in this folder is encrypted with this password. Keep it safe: without it your writing will not open, and there is no way to recover it.
computador.abrir.texto: The writing in this folder is encrypted. Type the password to open it.
computador.erro.senha-curta: The password needs at least {n} characters.
computador.erro.diferentes: The two passwords do not match.
computador.erro.pasta: That folder cannot be used. Choose a folder you can write to.
computador.erro.nao-abre: The writing in this folder could not be opened. The file may be damaged.
computador.erro.fechada: Your writing is closed. Open it with the password.
computador.espelho.texto: Writer can keep a copy of your writing in this folder as .md files, always up to date, that open in any editor on any computer.
computador.espelho.aviso: Note: this copy is not encrypted. Anyone with the folder can read your writing without the password.
computador.ajustes.espelho-ligado: Markdown copy: on, in the folder {pasta}
computador.ajustes.espelho-desligado: Markdown copy: off (it is not encrypted).
computador.ajustes.espelho-atrasado: The Markdown copy is still being written.
computador.ajustes.trancar: Close your writing and change folders
computador.servidor.sem-cadastro: This server does not accept new accounts: sign in with an account that already exists there.
computador.servidor.erro.endereco: That address does not look right.
computador.servidor.erro.rede: Could not reach that address. Check the internet and the address.
computador.servidor.erro.nao-e-ekfrase: There is no Ekfrase server at that address.
computador.servidor.erro.protocolo: That server speaks another version of Writer. Update the app or the server.
baixar.texto: Write without internet, on Windows or Linux. Your writing stays in a folder of yours, on the computer or on a USB drive, encrypted with your password, and goes to the cloud when you sign in.
baixar.windows.texto: The installer does not have a code signing certificate yet. That is why Windows shows a warning the first time:
baixar.windows.1: Open the downloaded file. If "Windows protected your PC" appears, click "More info".
baixar.windows.3: Follow the installer. The Ekfrase Writer shortcut appears on the desktop and in the Start menu.
baixar.linux.texto: Give the file permission to run (in Properties, or chmod +x in the terminal) and open it with a double click.
baixar.codigo: Writer's code is free (MPL-2.0) and is on GitHub.
computador.erro.ja-tem: This drive already has Writer texts. Choose another one.
os.boas-vindas: Welcome to Ekfrase Writer. Before you write, four quick questions. Use the arrows, Tab and Enter.
os.teclado.texto: Which keyboard does this computer have? It decides where accents and symbols are.
os.teclado.reabrindo: Changing the keyboard. Writer opens again in a few seconds.
os.teclado.confirmar: To change the keyboard, Writer closes and opens again (your text stays saved and the password is asked again).
os.fuso.texto: So the dates of versions and the daily goal are right.
os.senha.aviso: Without this password the texts on this drive cannot be opened, here or on any other computer. Your backups are the cloud (with an account) and the .md copy.
os.onde.texto: This drive has no data part. Choose another USB stick, SSD or external disk, or write in memory only.
os.onde.motivo.sem-espaco: (There is no free space left on the boot drive for the data part.)
os.onde.motivo.nao-usb: (Writer started from a disk that is not USB; it only creates the data part on USB disks.)
os.onde.motivo.sem-medio: (Writer could not find the disk it started from.)
os.onde.motivo.nao-monta: (The data part exists but did not open. It may be damaged.)
os.onde.motivo.sem-servico: (The system did not report where the data is.)
os.onde.motivo.nao-grava: (The data part does not accept writing.)
os.onde.sem-disco: No other USB drive plugged in. Plug one in and it shows up here.
os.onde.memoria.dica: Everything is lost on shutdown, except what goes to the cloud or to a drive.
os.onde.ja-tem: This drive already has Writer texts. Choose another one, or open its texts on the previous screen.
os.memoria.faixa: Your texts are in memory only: they are lost on shutdown.
os.memoria.levar: Everything in memory goes to the chosen drive. Then the password is asked again (the same one).
os.wifi.texto: With internet, your texts go to the cloud (if you have an account). Without internet, Writer works the same.
os.wifi.erro.senha: The password did not work. Check it and try again.
os.wifi.erro.falhou: Could not connect. If this network asks you to log in on a page, use another network for now.
os.wifi.erro.negado: The system did not allow this connection.
os.conta.dica: Signing in, out and switching accounts are on the account button at the top.
os.discos.erro.falhou: Could not eject: something is still using the drive. Try again in a few seconds.
os.discos.erro.negado: This drive cannot be ejected from here.
os.desligar.confirmar: Shut down the computer? The open text is saved first.
os.reiniciar.confirmar: Restart the computer? The open text is saved first.
os.onde.motivo.outras-particoes: (The boot drive already has other partitions; Writer does not touch them.)
os.onde.motivo.nao-cria: (Could not create the data part on the drive.)
baixar.ir-os: Prefer a USB drive that boots straight into Writer, without the rest of the computer? Meet Writer OS.
os-pagina.titulo: Ekfrase Writer OS: the operating system that boots straight into Writer
os-pagina.texto: A system just for writing: boot the computer from it and Writer appears, with no distracting internet and no other programs. Your writing stays encrypted on the drive itself. To create the drive, download the Drive Creator (a single program, nothing to install):
os-pagina.passo-1: Plug in the flash drive (or an external SSD or hard drive) and choose it in the Drive Creator. The computer's own disk never shows up.
os-pagina.passo-2: Check what will be erased, type the drive's name and click Create. The Drive Creator downloads Writer OS, checks the Ekfrase seal, writes and verifies.
os-pagina.passo-3: Done: the Drive Creator shows the boot menu key for each brand. There is no need to turn Secure Boot off.
os-pagina.nao-publicado: The Drive Creator has not been published yet. Until then, you can create the drive with Rufus or balenaEtcher (see below).
os-pagina.windows: Download the Drive Creator for Windows (.exe)
os-pagina.linux: Download the Drive Creator for Linux (AppImage)
os-pagina.midias.texto: A flash drive, portable SSD or external hard drive of at least 4 GB (8 GB or more is better, ideally USB 3). Everything on it is erased: use a drive just for Writer.
os-pagina.smartscreen: The Drive Creator does not have a signing certificate yet, so the first time Windows shows "Windows protected your PC". To open it:
os-pagina.permissao: When it is time to write, Windows asks whether the Drive Creator may make changes: that is the permission to write to the chosen drive (every USB writer asks for it).
os-pagina.rufus.texto: The Writer OS image also works with them (in Rufus, use DD mode).
os-pagina.todas: All versions, the source code and the image
cmd.inicio: Go to home (write on the web, on the computer, on a USB stick)
inicio.web.texto: Open your stories right here in the browser. What you write stays on this device or in your account, as you chose.
passeio.casca: The castle on the computer arrives with the Ekfrase Engine. For now, it lives at ekfrase.com.
cmd.sem-menus-ligar: Write with no menus (hide the top and the footer)
cmd.sem-menus-desligar: Bring the menus back to the writing sheet
ajustes.sem-menus-dica: The top and the footer disappear and only come back with the mouse at the edge of the screen, with Esc or with Alt+M.
importar.outro-app-os: This file belongs to the {app} app. It does not open in Writer OS: open it in {app}, on another computer.
os.sobre.licenca: Ekfrase Writer is free software (MPL-2.0 license); the Ekfrase name is reserved.
os.sobre.privacidade: Your texts stay on this drive, encrypted with your password. They only leave it if you sign in to an Ekfrase account (to sync) or send feedback.
os.pendrive.arquivo: The file "{nome}" goes into the chosen folder.
os.pendrive.lista: Folders and files on the USB drive
os.pendrive.vazia: No folders or Writer files here (Writer imports .ekfr, .md, .txt and .zip).
os.pendrive.sem-pastas: No folders here. You can save in this very folder.
os.pendrive.dica: Enter opens the folder. The space bar ticks the file. Esc goes back.
os.pendrive.salvo: Saved to the USB drive as "{nome}". To remove the drive, eject it from the system panel.
os.pendrive.erro.negado: That place is not a USB drive.
os.pendrive.erro.falhou: Could not read or write the USB drive. Check that it is still plugged in.
os.pendrive.erro.grande: The file is too large (the limit is 64 MB).
entrada.os.texto: Ekfrase Writer OS is an operating system of its own: put it on a USB stick or external SSD, start the computer from it and the machine opens straight into Writer, with no Windows and no distractions. Write on any computer and take everything with you.
